endpoint.label: LM Studio local endpoint
endpoint.scope: public route identity; actual inference backend is not verified

collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

channel_topology.note: Populated channels inferred from explicit firmware channel/slot labels, not DIMM count. Active controller mode is unverified.

memory.note: Channel topology includes its source and detection method; populated channels do not verify active controller mode. Module count does not establish channels. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; measured transfer probes are stored separately.

pcie.maximum_scope: driver-reported platform/adapter limit; physical slot wiring and card lane capability are unverified
pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits and do not prove the card or physical slot supports that lane count. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

storage_to_ram.note: Sequential reads of a flushed temporary file on the selected volume (results volume by default). File creation is excluded. Device/controller caches may contribute; model files on other volumes need separate measurement.

ram_copy_single.note: Native RAM copy payload throughput. Each payload byte requires a source read and destination write; 2x this rate is logical read+write bandwidth, not measured DRAM bus traffic. Cache/write-allocation effects and worker count influence results.

ram_copy_parallel.note: Native RAM copy payload throughput. Each payload byte requires a source read and destination write; 2x this rate is logical read+write bandwidth, not measured DRAM bus traffic. Cache/write-allocation effects and worker count influence results.

history.gpu_power_aggregation: sum of all monitored GPU board power; missing readings make the total unavailable
history.vram_aggregation: sum of physical used/capacity readings; separate per-card allocations
history.gpu_util_aggregation: unweighted mean of per-card utilization percentages
history.system_power_boundary: GPU board power plus CPU and other-system estimates; not a wall-meter measurement
history.note: Whole-client CPU/RAM and the declared GPU boundary; not inference-process isolation. All-card totals require every card reading. Driver snapshots are held only while fresh. CPU temperature needs an actual sensor (cpu_temp_source names it; cpu_temp_note says why it is missing). Summary preserves all observations despite ring eviction.
